programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Mega - Dubai
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name on several occasions depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is the Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games, each against each other, one at home and one away, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differed from season to season.

programme.title: Košarka - Liga prvaka: Spartak - Cholet
programme.desc: Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina Basketball Champions League. Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji Euroleague Basketball S.L. i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. programme.desc: Eurocup was created in 2002 as the second competition of Euroleague Basketball. The strongest basketball clubs that fail to qualify for the Euroleague compete in this competition, and mostly clubs from the top 15 strongest European leagues participate in it. Placement in the Eurocup is secured through national championships and cups, and through invitations to the so-called wildcards. The second strongest competition in European basketball was created by the merger of the FIBA ​​Radivoje Korać Cup and the Saporta Cup. The significance of this competition is that the winner secures the right to participate in the next season in the strongest club basketball competition in Europe, the Euroleague.
